title: I made a free browser typing game with over-the-top anime bosses, built with AI end to end
author: adachinkovsky
selftext:
Play it here (free, no signup): [https://semput.com/galtype/](https://semput.com/galtype/)

Girls run at you and you type their words to fend them off. A full 6-stage run takes 15 to 30 minutes.

**How it was made:**

* Sprites: Animagine XL 4.0 in ComfyUI, with one seed and an IP-Adapter reference per girl to keep her look consistent. Each girl has 5 frames (walk x2, idle, flustered, rejected) because my PC is weak.
* Code: plain JS and canvas with no engine, mostly written with Claude.
* Music and SFX: free libraries, looped and edited.

**What’s still rough:** sprite consistency between frames still drifts, and the music is limited to what I had on hand.

Only about 25% of players have finished it so far. Feedback welcome, especially on the AI art pipeline.
